mentions.name: NYC Coffee Map
mentions.description: A React Native mobile app that maps all coffee shops in New York City. It integrates with Google Places to return AI-generated summaries of each coffee shop via Google's AI summary feature. Planned next steps include building a local LLM into the app to replace the Google integration and power question-and-answer features; for now it is a quick app to help find coffee.
